name: Select
description: An accessible single-value picker with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and collision-aware positioning.
usage:
<Select
  aria-label="Role"
  defaultValue="viewer"
  options={[
    { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
    { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The button that shows the current value or placeholder and opens the listbox.
The collision-aware listbox popup, sized to the trigger's measured width.
A selectable row with a check indicator on the current value; disabled options are skipped.

dos: Order options predictably, such as alphabetically or most common first.
Provide an aria-label when the select has no visible Field label.
Keep option labels short so the trigger stays on one line.
donts: Don't use Select for two or three options; use RadioGroup or SegmentedControl.
Don't use it when typing should filter a long list; use Combobox.
Don't hide critical context in the placeholder; it disappears once a value is chosen.

examples.title: Controlled selection
examples.description: Select is controlled through value and onValueChange with an options array.

examples.title: Placeholder and disabled option
examples.description: An uncontrolled select can show placeholder text, and individual options can be disabled.

examples.title: Role assignment
examples.description: Use a labeled picker when a person must choose one role.

examples.title: Keyboard selection
examples.description: Typeahead and arrow-key navigation keep long option lists efficient.

guidance.useWhen: Users choose one value from a known list.
guidance.avoidWhen: There are only two choices or users need to compare all options at once.
guidance.behavior: Radix manages keyboard navigation, typeahead, focus, and collision handling.
guidance.responsive: The trigger fills its parent width and the menu follows its measured width.

keyboard.action: Opens the listbox and highlights the selected option.
Highlights the first or last option.
Typeahead jumps to the first matching option.
Commits the highlighted option and closes the listbox.
Closes the listbox without changing the value.

notes: Provide aria-label when the select has no visible label; the demo options render visible text either way.
Disabled options are skipped during keyboard navigation and typeahead.
